question: Why doesn’t Reinhard walk around carring anything besides the Dragon Sword Reid? Since he knows he won’t be able to draw it in most situations, if he carried another regular sword around, he wouldn’t have to be borrowing one all the time. Is it an indication that he’s confident he can win even without a sword?
answer: He feels that even if he doesn’t carry one with him, he’ll be able to find what he needs, when he needs it.
